_meta.notes: Seed prices for the SaaSpare Price Intelligence Engine. All values verified from official vendor pricing pages on the snapshot_date. The crawler will diff future snapshots against these values. Inaccurate values destroy trust faster than missing values — better to omit a plan than guess. 2026-09-06: HubSpot and Ahrefs plans re-verified against live vendor pages. The stored seat_minimum values for HubSpot Professional (5), HubSpot Enterprise (10), Ahrefs Advanced (3) and Ahrefs Enterprise (5) were NOT supported by the vendors' current pricing pages and have been reset to 1. Mandatory one-time onboarding fees recorded in notes. 2026-09-06: Salesforce Sales Cloud re-verified - Enterprise and Unlimited tiers retired, replaced by Core/Advanced/Max, and Starter/Pro repriced. 2026-09-06: expanded from 15 to 41 tools. Every new plan read off the vendor's own pricing page the same day. Vendors that could not be verified cleanly were SKIPPED, not guessed - see skipped_vendors for the reason on each. Geolocated (AUD/INR) and promo-discounted pages were rejected rather than recorded in the wrong currency or at a temporary rate.

skipped_vendors.surfshark: AUD term-based pricing (24-month intro vs renewal); does not fit the monthly/annual schema
skipped_vendors.canva: Business tier listed $250/month AND $250/year - internally contradictory
skipped_vendors.descript: Annual column cheaper than monthly, contradicting the page's own '35% savings' note
skipped_vendors.zoom: prices render client-side, not in HTML
skipped_vendors.hootsuite: prices only in FAQ prose, billing frequency unclear
skipped_vendors.mailchimp: quoted prices are promo-discounted and contact-tier dependent
